reason: The frozen bridge failed four Romanian development decisions. The focus/context student corrected those decisions but regressed on the exposed v9 regression. Evaluate a learned combination without case-specific rules.
exposure: Development, challenge and old v9 regression have already been inspected. None is an independent final test. Development becomes meta-training for this experiment.
features: frozen neural logit minus its released threshold logit
frozen student logit minus its threshold logit
estimator: Nonnegative logistic weights with quadratic regularization toward the frozen neural decision; free intercept with the same regularization.
selection: Leave one scenario family out within each language; minimize out-of-family binary errors, then prefer greater regularization. Fit the selected setting on development only.
evaluation: Report out-of-family development predictions separately from fitted-development results; subsequently evaluate the already-exposed diagnostic and v9 regression once. Keep all failures.
prohibited: selecting regularization using regression or calibration results
promotion: Still requires all existing gates, including independent evaluation and measured reviewer benefit. This experiment cannot establish a perfect v10.
